Sample and scope: N=18 names, 32 seat filings, one session. Under C10 a short run is not evidence of decay, so nothing here is a finding against any seat's process — only against what that seat wrote today. Correlations on n=18 are descriptive; I attach no significance claim to them.

Menu discipline (D-29): I read only my own data taxonomy — ticker, gics_sector_name, sc_momentum, lens_warnings, day_vol, ma_50/100/200, structure, structure_shift, atr_14d, bracket and its sub-fields, div_state, div_bear_count. ma_20 and entry price appear in the brief's data rows and I used them to locate stops relative to the MA stack.
